fact: On 7 August 2026 UDI Malawi and HISP-UNIMA held a pre-pilot launch workshop in Dedza District to prepare stakeholders for the pilot rollout of the DHIS2-based EMIS platform in additional schools across the district, with GPE KIX support.
title: UDI Malawi Hosts DHSI2 Platform Pre-Pilot Launch Workshop in Dedza District
